cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whether I broke the window is outside this repair meeting. Put responsibility under a separate heading, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let's discuss that heading now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the glass is cleared. We need a safe venue before opening another item.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can talk outside while the cleaner works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then add relocation to the agenda. Specify where outside; I won't open responsibility while the meeting arrangements are still unsettled.
